about: GTA 6's mountain, Mount Kalaga: Rockstar's own page calls it 'A national landmark up against the state’s northern border' that 'offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails', with 'hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals' in the backwoods 'far from the prying eyes of the government' (rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/kalaga, read 2026-11-01). One REAL WORLD beat, scoped in the voice: Florida's highest natural point, Britton Hill, is 345 feet (USGS, Elevations and Distances in the United States). The film never says Leonida is Florida and never gives Mount Kalaga a height (Rockstar doesn't). Ends on an open one-word question that loops into line 1. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Delta.

lines.say: G T A 6 has a mountain.

lines.text: In the real world, Florida tops out at 345 feet.

lines.text: A national landmark up against the state's northern border.
Plus prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails.
And in the backwoods? Hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals.
Far from the prying eyes of the government.
But Rockstar never gives its height.
So, mountain or hill? One word.
